## Description
Briefly describe what this PR does, what workflows/actions are affected, and why the change is needed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking addition of a workflow/action/input)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing caller workflows to fail)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix or enhancement
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI maintenance

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the repository's code style and security practices.
- [ ] I have updated documentation (README, examples, changelog) accordingly.
- [ ] I have added/updated unit tests or validated YAML workflows.
- [ ] No internal credentials, tokens, or organization-specific URLs are present.
- [ ] All new and existing CI checks pass.
